issue.title: [BUG] read_file reports inverted line range when offset is past EOF

steps: Create a file named test.txt containing exactly three lines: `a`, `b`, `c`.
Use read_file on test.txt (a 3-line file) with offset 10 and show the output.
expected: Reading past EOF reports an explicit empty range such as `lines 0-0 of 3` and renders no line-number marker.
defect: The output header shows an inverted range `test.txt (lines 10-3 of 3, ...)` followed by a phantom line `10→`.
Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/17275 (commit 847ff1e0d94368d94b2e173e4e0908e115568ef3). Before the fix, extractLines in packages/core/src/workspace/line-utils.ts clamped the end of the requested range to the file length but kept the requested start, so an offset past EOF produced start > end (10 > 3) with empty content; read-file.ts then formatted that range into the header (`lines 10-3 of 3`) and called formatWithLineNumbers(result.content, result.lines.start), which renders a numbered marker `10→` for the empty content. The fix returns { content: '', lines: { start: 0, end: 0 } } when start > end and skips line numbering when no lines were extracted. The fix (2026-05-29) is first released in mastracode@0.21.2 (@mastra/core@1.38.0); the pinned revision mastracode@0.41.0 already contains it and no pre-fix mastracode release has the ACP entry (first in 0.25.0), so the case is pinned and is not expected to reproduce.
